Title: New Dv2 instances for Azure HDInsight

Body.Content: We’re announcing a new instance size, D5 v2, that extends the Dv2-Series for Azure HDInsight. D5 v2 has 16 cores and 56 GB of memory. Dv2-Series nodes are currently available in Australia East, Australia Southeast, West US, East US, East US 2, South Central US, North Central US, Central US, North Europe, West Europe, East Asia, Southeast Asia, and Japan East. For more information, please visit the HDInsight and HDInsight pricing pages.
